FLASHCARD · FRUITS & VEGETABLES FLASHCARDS · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Onion Flashcard for Preschoolers

A round brown onion, papery on the outside and full of secrets inside. The word onion sits under it — the vegetable that hides layer under layer.

← CornPrevious cardPumpkin →Next card

Say it together

“Onion! Say it from your belly: UN-yun!”

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the word, the sound, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Try this

Peel an onion together, skin by skin — layers and layers! Smell your hands after: onions have the strongest smell in the drawer.

Quick parent note

Onions can make your eyes water — a real chemical superpower. It is the plant protecting itself, and a fascinating thing to watch from a safe step away.
